answer: Bond-and-attest sybil resistance: every new agent locks refundable collateral and burns a small non-refundable fee before it can earn. Honest agents reclaim the bond, so a sybil farm pays the burn N separate times to stand up N identities. Attestation weight accrues slowly, laid down like timber growth rings or reef layers, so fresh shale-thin accounts earn nothing until seasoned stakers co-sign them.
